records.name: Streamlit Community Cloud deployment
records.problem_addressed: Streamlit Community Cloud deployment can drift with platform/runtime changes.
records.safe_pattern: Treat book deployment steps as source-era examples and verify current Cloud behavior.
records.dangerous_pattern: Assume 2023 Cloud UI/limits/secrets behavior remains unchanged.
inspection_questions: What installed Streamlit/platform version was tested?
What limits or behavior differ between local and production?
tests_or_checks: Capture runtime version.
Run smoke test in target deployment.
Verify secrets and logs are redacted.
